title: Attachments
help: Only documents and images (PDF, HWP, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, PNG/JPG) up to 10 MB each. No limit on the number of files.
itemHelp: Members of the handling department upload and delete files (including files uploaded by others). Files can be added after completion, but not to rejected or transferred work.

errors.default: Upload failed. Please try again later.
errors.FILE_BUSY: Many files are being uploaded. Please try again in a moment.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file type is not allowed (executables, archives, etc.).
errors.WORK_STATE: Files cannot be added to rejected or transferred work.
errors.FILE_EXECUTABLE: Executable files (exe, msi, bat, cmd, com, scr, ps1, vbs, js, jar, sh) cannot be uploaded.

preview.loadFailed: Could not load the document. Download the original instead.
preview.unsupported: This file type cannot be previewed. Download the original instead.
preview.hwpFailed: This HWP file could not be shown as pages. Try again or download the original.
preview.docxFailed: This Word document cannot be previewed. It may be damaged or use unsupported content. Download the original instead.
preview.sheetFailed: This Excel workbook cannot be previewed. It may be damaged or use an unsupported structure. Download the original.
preview.sheetTruncated: The sheet is large; only the first {rows} rows and {cols} columns are shown. Download the original to see everything.
preview.slideFailed: This PowerPoint file cannot be previewed. It may be damaged or use an unsupported structure. Download the original.
preview.slideNotice: Shows the text, tables and pictures of each slide in order. Download the original for its layout and formatting.
preview.slideEmpty: This slide has no text or pictures to show.
preview.slideTruncated: Only the first {count} slides are shown. Download the original to see everything.
